pages.text: Ruined towers drift among the Hollow's islands, each on its own crumbling shard of stone. Someone built them. Someone lived in them.$(br2)Their chests still hold supplies, and $(l)Lost Pages$(): fragments of a journal much like this one.
pages.title: The Ruined Towers

pages.text: Right-click a Lost Page to read it. Each one you piece together is copied into this journal and grants $(l)5 Knowledge$(). Pages are always read in order.
